subject: potion
text: In Chapter 7 toward the end of Dracula's castle in the room with two Frankensteins where you had to hit a switch to exit to the west, you can bust through the wall to the north for an extra potion.

evidence.quote:
In Chapter 7, toward the end of Dracula's castle, in the
room with two Frankensteins, where you had to hit a switch
to exit to the west, you can bust through the wall to the
north for an extra potion.

subject: switch
text: In the room with 2 frankie dudes, grab the hearts and get the switch in the right set.

evidence.quote:
The rest is pretty straightforward until you get to a room with 2 frankie dudes.  Grab the 
hearts, and get the switch in the right set.

subject: doorway
text: In the room with the sleepwalking guys, the switch is in the top right set, and killing the enemies opens a doorway to medicine and weaponry.

evidence.quote:
Keep going till 
the room with the sleepwalking guys.  The switch is in the top right set.  If you kill the 
enemies a doorway opens up to some medicine and weaponry.

subject: tile switches
text: In the room with tiles shaped like a bat, kill the bats to open a doorway, and hit the tile switches in the top left corner and bottom right corner.

evidence.quote:
Kill the bats, then kill the Electro Franky guy, and 
then you should be in a room with tiles shaped like a bat.  Kill the bats to open a doorway, 
and there are tile switches in the top left corner and bottom right corner.

subject: Tetrad
text: Collecting the Tetrad increases your life level.

evidence.quote: _***You've got a Tetrad!  Your life level is increased!***_

subject: King Arthur
text: King Arthur christens Mike Sir Mike and your life level is increased.

evidence.quote:
I hereby christen you, Sir Mike!

_***Your life level is increased!***_

subject: path
text: Talking to the guy blocking your path outside allows access to Dragon's Cave.

evidence.quote:
Go outside and talk to the guy blocking your path, and he'll allow 
you access to...

DRAGON'S CAVE

subject: blob
text: When killing the last blob, stand near the middle-top of the screen to fall through the floor onto a platform.

evidence.quote:
When you kill the last blob, make sure you're standing near the middle-top of the screen, 
because you'll fall through the floor onto a platform.

subject: potion
text: Hit the pile o' bones down and jump over them to grab a potion, then go around the left to grab the other potion.

evidence.quote:
Go up the left pathway with the pile o' bones', hit them 
so they're down, and jump over them.  Grab the potion and head back, then go around the left.  
Go around, grab the other potion

subject: conveyer belt
text: In the conveyer belt rooms, take the shortcut halfway through the first room, take up then down in the second, take up and down in the third, and take down then middle in the last room.

evidence.quote:
In the first one, take the shortcut halfway 
through.  In the second room, take the up path, then the down.  And in the third room, take 
up and down again.  Then in the last room, take down, then middle.

subject: Merlin
text: Merlin instructs Mike to collect the last Tetrad and grants the last and most powerful magic.

evidence.quote: You must now collect the last Tetrad and put them all together...I will now give you the last and most powerful magic

subject: Ultra Psychic Shockwave
text: You obtain the Ultra Psychic Shockwave.

evidence.quote: _***You've got the Ultra Psychic Shockwave***_

subject: switch
text: Kill the bats to open a secret, hit the switch in the bottom left, hit the switch in the bottom right, and grab the medicine.

evidence.quote:
Grab the hearts and kill the bats to open a secret.  Grab the stuff and the 
switch in the bottom left.  There's a switch in the bottom right now.  Grab the medicine

subject: switch
text: Jump on the moving platform onto the ledge, grab hearts, hit the switch, and collect the orb to move on.

evidence.quote:
Jump on the moving platform and onto the 
ledge, and then grab the hearts, hit the switch, and collect the orb to move on.

subject: tile switches
text: Hit the tile switch in the third last row for medicine, and hit the tile switch in the third row to open the door.

evidence.quote:
hit the 
tile switches.  There's one for a medicine (watch out for fire around it) in the third last 
row, and one to open the door in the third row.

subject: Tetrad
text: Grab the Tetrad after defeating the Dragon.

evidence.quote: Yeah yeah, grab the Tetrad, move on outside...

subject: Cave
text: In town on C-Island, talk to the only human and enter the Cave.

evidence.quote:
go to town, talk to the only human, and go into...

CAVE

subject: conveyor belt
text: In Chapter 9 on the conveyor belt in the dungeon section, the top route has very few potions and the bottom route has the most.

evidence.quote:
In Chapter 9, in the dungeon section on the conveyor belt,
the top route actually has very few potions and the bottom
route has the most.

subject: Zoda
text: In the Dungeon, fight all the bosses again faster, and then fight Zoda.

evidence.quote:
you will fight all 
the bosses again, except they're FASTER!!!  NOOOO!!!!  Then you fight Zoda.

subject: Wild Boar
text: The Wild Boar is the equivalent of the slug in Star Tropics, but faster.

evidence.quote: Wild Boar:  It's a wild boar.  The equivalent of the slug in Star Tropics, but faster.

subject: Salamander
text: The Salamander is a long enemy that moves slowly and takes a few hits to kill.

evidence.quote: Salamander:  It's a long enemy, moves slowly, takes a few hits to kill.

subject: Grizzly
text: The Grizzly walks forward and swings his paw.

evidence.quote: Grizzly:  It's a grizzly bear.  He walks forward and swings his paw.

subject: Fire Man
text: The Fire Man is made out of fire, walks forward, and speeds up sometimes.

evidence.quote: Fire Man:  It's a man made out of fire.  He'll walk forward, and speed up some times.

subject: Hedgehog
text: The Hedgehog is invulnerable when rolling, so attack it when it is not facing you.

evidence.quote: Hedgehog:  It's a hedgehog.  It's invulnerable when rolling...facing you.

subject: Tarantula
text: The Tarantula walks forward and shoots a little pellet once in a while.

evidence.quote:
Tarantula:  It's a tarantula.  It'll walk forward, and shoot a little pellet once and a 
while.

subject: Knife Weilding Egyptian Guy
text: The Knife Weilding Egyptian Guy functions like the Grizzly.

evidence.quote: Knife Weilding Egyptian Guy:  It's a knife-weilding Egyptian guy.  See Grizzly.

subject: Scorpion
text: The Scorpion walks around and some shoot pellets.

evidence.quote: Scorpion:  It's a scorpion.  It walks around.  Some shoot pellets/bullets/things.

subject: Floor Tile
text: The Floor Tile looks like moving floor and shows its eyes every few seconds.

evidence.quote:
Floor Tile:  It's a floor tile thing.  It looks like the floor is moving, but it shows its 
eyes...every few seconds.

subject: One-Eyed Monkey
text: The One-Eyed Monkey is the equivalent of the octopus enemies in Star Tropics.

evidence.quote:
One-Eyed Monkey:  It's a one-eyed monkey.  The equivalent of those octopus things in Star 
Tropics.

subject: Ducks
text: The Duck swims around and fires a bullet from time to time.

evidence.quote: Ducks:  It's a duck.  It'll swim around, and fire a bullet from time to time.

subject: Crocodile
text: The Crocodile behaves similarly to the Salamander.

evidence.quote: Crocodile:  It's a crocodile.  See Salamander.

subject: Jelly
text: The Jelly is a jellyfish that floats around diagonally.

evidence.quote: Jelly:  It's a jellyfish.  It'll float around diagnally.

subject: Hippo
text: The Hippo is the equivalent of Mad Muddy from Star Tropics.

evidence.quote: Hippo:  It's a hippo.  The equivalent of Mad Muddy from Star Tropics.

subject: Skull Thing
text: The Skull Thing wears a skull mask and charges at you.

evidence.quote: Skull Thing:  It's some tiny thing wearing a skull mask.  It'll charge at you.

subject: Cobra
text: The Cobra is very quick and very shifty.

evidence.quote: Cobra:  It's a cobra.  Very quick, and very shifty.  Tricky ones these are.

subject: Sleep-Walking Dude
text: You need the Psychic Shockwave to defeat the Sleep-Walking Dude.

evidence.quote:
Sleep-Walking Dude:  It's a sleep-walking dude.  You need the Psychic Shockwave to beat 
these.

subject: Mummy
text: The Mummy is huge, walks slowly, and can speed up.

evidence.quote: Mummy:  It's a huge mummy.  It walks slow, but can speed up.

subject: Mini-Mummy
text: The Mini-Mummy is very fast and never stops walking.

evidence.quote: Mini-Mummy:  It's a tiny mummy.  It's very fast, and never takes breaks from walking.

subject: Horus
text: Horus wears a bird mask and stops walking to fire bullets.

evidence.quote: Horus:  It's a guy with a bird mask.  He'll stop walking to fire those bullet things at you.

subject: Pile 'o Bones
text: The Pile 'o Bones break apart when hit, regenerate after a while, and cannot be defeated.

evidence.quote: Pile 'o Bones:  It's a pile of bones.  They'll break apart and lie there when you hit them...after a while they'll come back together.  They cannot be defeated.

subject: Rat
text: The Rat walks around.

evidence.quote: Rat:  It's a rat.  It'll just walk around.

subject: Bouncy Ball
text: The Bouncy Ball is a bouncing blue ball that bounces around.

evidence.quote: Bouncy Ball:  It's a bouncing blue ball.  It'll just bounce around.

subject: Big Rat
text: The Big Rat behaves like the Knife-Weilding Egyptian Guy.

evidence.quote: Big Rat:  It's a big rat.  See Knife-Weilding Egyptian Guy.

subject: Owl
text: The Owl flies around, requiring you to jump or stand on higher ground to hit it.

evidence.quote: Owl:  It's an owl.  It flies around, and you have to jump or be on higher ground to hit it.

subject: Larva
text: The Larva is a string of alien goo equivalent to the pieces falling off Zoda in Star Tropics.

evidence.quote:
Larva:  It's some weird string of alien goo...that fell of of 
Zoda...in Star Tropics.

subject: Green Thing
text: The Green Thing floats around and stops to shoot bullets in 3 directions.

evidence.quote:
Green Thing:  Some green thing that floats and has a tail...It floats around and stops to shoot bullet things in 3 
directions.

subject: Particle Man
text: When Particle Man is defeated, his body breaks apart and flies in 4 directions.

evidence.quote:
Particle Man:  It's a dude.  When you defeat it, its body breaks apart and flies in 4 
directions.

subject: Chest
text: Defeat hopping Chests with the shockwave, or else all of them in the room turn into fast-moving coins.

evidence.quote:
Chest:  It's a chest.  It hops around, shoots projectiles every few seconds.  Defeat it with 
the...shockwave, or else everyone of them in the room will turn into coins

subject: Mine Rider
text: The Mine Rider drives on a track in a mine cart releasing wee fire men.

evidence.quote: Mine Rider:  It's a guy in a mine cart.  Drives on a track releasing wee fire men.

subject: Wee Fire Men
text: Wee Fire Men are tiny versions of the Fire Man.

evidence.quote: Wee Fire Men:  It's a tiny version of the Fire Man.  See Mini-mummy.

subject: Miner Dude
text: The Miner Dude is a ghost that can be destroyed with the shockwave.

evidence.quote: Miner Dude:  It's a ghost...destroyed with the shockwave.

subject: Skull
text: Skulls spin around the room and stop to shoot projectiles in 3 directions.

evidence.quote:
Skull:  It's a skull.  They spin around the room and stop to shoot bullet thingys in 3 
directions.

subject: Bat
text: The Bat is equivalent to the bat from Star Tropics, but more shifty and unpredictable.

evidence.quote:
Bat:  It's a bat.  Equivalent of the bat from Star Tropics, but a lot more shifty and
unpredictable.

subject: Frankie
text: When Frankie is hit a couple of times, his top half dies and his legs run around until defeated.

evidence.quote: Frankie:  It's Frankenstein.  When you hit him a couple of times, his top half will die and...legs will run around like crazy, and you have to kill those too.

subject: Ghost
text: Ghosts appear in packs with one colored lighter than the others; defeating that one kills them all.

evidence.quote:
Ghost:  It's a ghost.  They appear in packs, one coloured lighter than the others.  Kill that 
one...and they all die.

subject: Tombstone
text: The Tombstone ghost cannot be hurt while facing you, and attacks if struck from the front.

evidence.quote:
Tombstone:  It's a ghost that carries a tombstone.  You can't hurt it when it's facing you.  
If you...hit it when it's facing you, it'll attack.

subject: Reaper
text: The Reaper lays orbs that fly at high speeds if struck.

evidence.quote:
Reaper:  It's a hooded ghost.  He'll float around and lay the weird orbs.  If you hit the 
orbs...they'll fly at you at high speeds.

subject: Volt
text: Volt is a Frankenstein that lays mines exploding with sparks.

evidence.quote:
Volt:  It's another Frankenstein.  This one lays weird mines that explode with lots of funky
sparks.

subject: White Knight
text: The White Knight walks and shoots projectiles in 3 directions.

evidence.quote: White Knight:  It's a White Knight.  Walks and shoots bullet things in 3 directions.

subject: Big Bouncy Ball
text: After a couple hits, the Big Bouncy Ball breaks into 3 bouncy balls.

evidence.quote: Big Bouncy Ball:  It's a big bouncy ball.  After a couple hits it breaks into 3 bouncy balls.

subject: Triceratops
text: The Triceratops walks and shoots a fast moving ball of energy from its mouth.

evidence.quote:
Triceratops:  It's a triceratops.  It walks, and shoots a fast moving ball of energy from its
mouth.

subject: Gold Knight
text: The Gold Knight functions like the Tombstone, but attacks.

evidence.quote: Gold Knight:  It's a Gold Knight.  Works just like the Tombstone, but actually attacks.

subject: Yum Yum
text: Walk up and attack Yum Yum immediately upon entering the room because he will not attack until he finishes eating the Wild Boar.

evidence.quote:
Name: Yum Yum
Area: Yum Yum's Cave...As soon as you get in the room, walk up to him and attack.
He...won't attack you until he eats the Wild Boar on his plate.

subject: Yum Yum
text: Do not kill the pig on Yum Yum's plate, or he becomes angry and attacks.

evidence.quote:
Make sure you don't kill the 
pig though, because...then he gets really angry and actually does something.

subject: Giant Scorpion
text: Run up to attack Giant Scorpion, jump over his spread of projectiles, and destroy any small scorpions that approach.

evidence.quote:
Name: Giant Scorpion
Area: Border Pass...Just run up to him and attack.  After a couple of seconds he'll shoot a spread of 
tiny...fireballs/bullets/pebbles...Avoid the scorpion enemies

subject: Monster Mask
text: Attack Monster Mask using the Shockwave, noting that he turns red and moves faster after taking damage.

evidence.quote:
Name: Monster Mask
Area: Great Pyramid...attack using the Shockwave.  After some damage is dealt, Monster Mask will 
go red and...move faster.

subject: Monster Mask
text: Steer clear if Monster Mask opens his mouth to fire an energy beam, and continue attacking with the Shockwave.

evidence.quote:
Now he will either launch two spreads of bullets at a 
time, or open his...mouth and release a powerful energy beam.  Stear clear if he 
does that.  Continue to...attack with the Shockwave and finish him off.

subject: Zoda's Creature
text: Jump from platform to platform, stopping briefly to attack Zoda's Creature without falling off.

evidence.quote:
Name: Zoda's Creature
Area: Sewer...You have to jump from platform to platform, stopping briefly to throw in a few 
attacks.

subject: Zoda-X
text: Zoda-X teleports around the conveyor belt room, firing bullet spreads or summoning damaging rings of fire.

evidence.quote:
Name: Zoda-X
Area: Sewer, Part II...He'll teleport around the room, and either fire a spread of bullets, 
or make a..."ring" of fire around you.  Make sure that you don't hit the fire

subject: Boulder Tossing Miner
text: Use the bola against Boulder Tossing Miner, shooting low when he holds a rock up and jumping to shoot when he has it down.

evidence.quote:
Name: Boulder Tossing Miner
Area: Gold Cave...Use the bola if you got it.  Shoot low when he holds the rock up, jump and shoot 
when he...has it down.

subject: Mashing Miner
text: Jump immediately upon entering the room when Mashing Miner slams his hammer, and attack quickly with the Shockwave.

evidence.quote:
Name: Mashing Miner
Area: Gold Cave, Part II...As soon as the battle starts he will slam his hammer onto the ground...So, I suggest you jump as soon as you...get in the room...Use the Shockwave to...deal quick damage
